name: Summoner
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; moderate to high Eidolon skills; high Cha; low AC; low Reflex; high Will; moderate HP; high spell DC; spontaneous spellcasting (determined by the type of eidolon) as a summoner of their level; link spells; add an eidolon to the encounter of the appropriate type; Manifest Eidolon, Share Senses, Act Together

notes.defense: Low AC; low Reflex, high Will; moderate HP.
notes.spells: High spell DC. Spontaneous spellcasting of its eidolon's tradition as a summoner of its level: {maxrank}. Link spells.
notes.specials: Add an eidolon of the appropriate type to the encounter; Manifest Eidolon, Share Senses, Act Together.
